components.name: Button
components.description: A button triggers an action on the current screen: submit, validate, open a flow, confirm a decision.
components.commentary: No Negative tone in Figma but present in code (ButtonTone includes negative); Figma defaults differ for Loading state not yet in the ZeroHeight library sync.

components.name: Button Load More
components.description: A full-width button under a list that loads the next batch of results in place.
components.commentary: Figma-only name: in code it is ds-button type="secondary" tone="accent" fullWidth (story LoadMore).

components.name: Button Icon
components.description: A square button that carries an action with an icon only, for compact toolbars, rows and close buttons.
components.commentary: Code has no icon input (icon is projected); Figma exposes State, Type, Size, Reversed, Tone (incl. Negative), Focus.

components.name: Button Range
components.description: A small square button that represents one step of a scale, used in groups to pick a value, several values or a range.
components.commentary: Uses --semantic-measurement-spacing-2xs which does not exist in _semantic.scss (padding falls back to nothing).

components.name: Button Range Group
components.description: A group of Button Range steps to pick a value, several values or a range.
components.commentary: No separate Figma set: the group is composed from Button Range instances.

components.name: Button Split
components.description: A main action button joined to a chevron button that opens a menu of related actions.
components.commentary: Missing aria-expanded on the chevron button (ZeroHeight audit 2026-11-04).

components.name: Visual Button
components.description: A large clickable card with an icon, a title and a short description, used to start one of a few distinct paths.
components.commentary: Selected state uses --semantic-color-static-background-subtle-informative, which does not exist in _semantic.scss.

components.name: Link
components.description: A text link that takes the user to another page, a section or an external resource.
components.commentary: Figma: only [DEPRECATED] Link is published, the two current sets (688:4202, 689:4239) are not; Crumb uses 688:4202.

components.name: Breadcrumb
components.description: A breadcrumb shows where the current page sits in the hierarchy and lets the user go back to a parent level.
components.commentary: Figma name Breadcrumb, selector ds-breadcrumbs (plural).

components.name: Crumb
components.description: One level of a breadcrumb: a link to a parent page, or the name of the current page.
components.commentary: Code, story, Figma and doc all in place.

components.name: Tab
components.description: A tab switches between views of the same content without leaving the page.
components.commentary: Library Tab has no icon; code has one per tab. The counter badge exists only as the counter input of ds-tab.

components.name: Segmented Control
components.description: A row of joined segments where exactly one is selected, to switch a view or set a value.
components.commentary: Figma set is named "Component 1"; mode="radio" exists for settings (a11y), tabs mode is the default.

components.name: Tag
components.description: A small, square-cornered label used to show, select or remove a filter value.
components.commentary: Figma defaults to Filter, code defaults to select; no Dropdown filter tag in code.

components.name: Chip
components.description: A rounded pill that shows a value the user can select, toggle or remove.
components.commentary: Remove glyph is a text character, not a ds-icon.

components.name: Tile
components.description: A square, selectable button with an icon and a short label, used to pick a type or a category.
components.commentary: Figma set is named "Tiles"; no focus-visible style in code; not used by any page yet.

components.name: Flyout Menu
components.description: A floating list of actions or options that opens from a trigger (button, dropdown, more icon).
components.commentary: Code, story, Figma and doc all in place.

components.name: Flyout Menu Item
components.description: One row of a Flyout Menu: an action or an option with an optional icon.
components.commentary: Figma component is called Flyout Item; selectable/selected check sits in a fixed 20px slot.

components.name: Flyout Menu Title
components.description: A non-interactive group title row inside a Flyout Menu.
components.commentary: No story of its own; covered by the Flyout Menu stories. Missing for ready: story.

components.name: Pagination
components.description: Pagination lets the user move through a long list split into pages.
components.commentary: Uses native <button> instead of ds-button; no focus-visible style.

components.name: Stepper
components.description: A vertical list of the steps of a flow that shows where the user is, what is done and what is blocked.
components.commentary: Figma is only a WIP frame (no component set); steps are clickable divs without role.

components.name: Input Text
components.description: A single-line field to enter and edit free text, with a label, optional prefix or suffix, and validation states.
components.commentary: Code, story, Figma and doc all in place.

components.name: Input Email
components.description: A single-line field dedicated to email addresses, with the browser email keyboard and validation.
components.commentary: Code, story, Figma and doc all in place.

components.name: Input Date
components.description: A single-line field to type or pick one date in a standard format, with a calendar icon.
components.commentary: Code, story, Figma and doc all in place.

components.name: Input Search
components.description: A single-line field to type a search or filter query, with a search icon and a clear button.
components.commentary: Clear button is a native <button> (composition rule gap).

components.name: Text Area
components.description: A multi-line field to enter longer free text, such as an address or a comment.
components.commentary: Figma name Text Area, selector ds-textarea.

components.name: Checkbox
components.description: Lets users select one or several independent options, with checked, unchecked and indeterminate states.
components.commentary: Some colors are set in TS (hard-coded values flagged by the ZeroHeight audit).

components.name: Radio
components.description: Lets users pick exactly one option from a small set of mutually exclusive choices.
components.commentary: No arrow-key navigation inside a group.

components.name: Toggle
components.description: A switch that turns a single setting or feature on or off, with immediate effect.
components.commentary: Hard-coded sizes and a 14px radius; no ariaLabel input.

components.name: Select
components.description: A form field that opens a list of predefined options to choose one value.
components.commentary: Figma has one Dropdown component, code has two (ds-select and ds-multi-select).

components.name: Multi Select
components.description: A form field that opens a list of options to choose several values, shown as tags.
components.commentary: Maps to the same Figma Dropdown as ds-select (multi variant).

components.name: Dropdown Flyout Menu
components.description: The floating option list opened by a Dropdown or a Standalone Dropdown, for single or multiple choice, flat or grouped.
components.commentary: Figma-only name: implemented by ds-flyout-menu + ds-flyout-menu-item (single/multi, flat/grouped).

components.name: Standalone Dropdown
components.description: A text trigger, without a field or a border, that opens a menu or a single-choice list for light choices next to content.
components.commentary: Story sits under Action while the Figma component lives in Data Entry.

components.name: Inline Edit
components.description: Shows a value as text and lets users edit it in place, with save, cancel and optional delete actions.
components.commentary: Story has no autodocs tag, so the Storybook link opens the Default story.

components.name: Date Range
components.description: A calendar panel to pick a single date or a start and end date, on one or two months.
components.commentary: Code, story, Figma and doc all in place.

components.name: Checkbox Card
components.description: A selectable card that combines a checkbox with a label, a description and optional content, for multi-selection among rich options.
components.commentary: Selected border and checked box use --semantic-color-interactive-background-main-default, which does not exist; no focus-visible style.

components.name: Radio Card
components.description: A selectable card for choosing one option among visually emphasized, mutually exclusive choices.
components.commentary: Radio is redrawn instead of composing ds-radio.

components.name: Select Button
components.description: A compact, icon-led button that users select or deselect to pick one or several predefined options.
components.commentary: Not used by any page; no focus-visible style.

components.name: Search Bar
components.description: The master of every scoped search bar: a 64px container with filter slots, a free-text field and the Search button.
components.commentary: Figma master "Search Bar" (slots Filters/Options) maps to code ds-search-bar-scoped; Figma retired the Search Bar Scoped set.

components.name: More Criteria
components.description: The advanced buyer criteria panel opened from the Search Bar, to refine a buyer search by status, options and address.
components.commentary: Figma component is new, not yet in the stable library set.

components.name: Search Bar (home)
components.description: The single free-text search bar of the home page, with recent searches and an advanced-search link.
components.commentary: Code-only; distinct from ds-search-bar-multi and ds-search-bar-scoped (checked in the audit). Missing for ready: Figma, doc.

components.name: Search Bar Multi
components.description: The earlier multi-type search bar (buyer ID type, country, query) used by Search v1.
components.commentary: Code-only, superseded in Figma by the Search Bar master (slots). Missing for ready: Figma, doc.

components.name: Tag Filter Chip
components.description: A filter chip that opens an option list and shows the picked values as tags.
components.commentary: Code-only; composes ds-chip internally. Missing for ready: Figma, doc.

components.name: Grid Selection
components.description: A picker of board grid layouts (Buyer Summary card builder).
components.commentary: Code-only; the Figma equivalent is the local Radio Card + Layout preview in the Buyer Summary file. Missing for ready: Figma, doc.

components.name: File Upload
components.description: A drop zone and file list to attach files with type and size limits.
components.commentary: No story and no Figma component yet. Missing for ready: story, Figma, doc.

components.name: Card
components.description: A white, bordered container that groups one coherent block of information on a grey page.
components.commentary: Figma has six Card types; code exposes tone/loading/elevated/noPadding (no subtle tone).

components.name: Widget Card
components.description: A card shell for board widgets: an optional title bar with actions above free content (chart, list, figures).
components.commentary: Figma name is Card with Slot.

components.name: Table Row
components.description: Rows and columns of comparable records, with optional selection, sorting and a row action menu.
components.commentary: Figma page is Data Grid / Table; one set for header, row and cells.

components.name: Table Cell
components.description: A data cell of a table row, with size and alignment.
components.commentary: Figma page marked Design WIP.

components.name: Table Cell Header
components.description: A column header cell with optional sorting.
components.commentary: Figma page marked Design WIP.

components.name: Table Cell Selection
components.description: A checkbox or radio cell for row selection.
components.commentary: Figma page marked Design WIP.

components.name: Table Cell Action
components.description: A row-end cell holding the row action menu trigger.
components.commentary: Figma page marked Design WIP.

components.name: Collapsible Table
components.description: A category bar that expands to reveal a table (or any tabular content) grouped under it.
components.commentary: The story hand-writes its HTML table rows.

components.name: Topbox
components.description: A one-line identity strip that names the buyer or policy a page is about, with its grade, identifier, critical flags and one action.
components.commentary: Story sits under Layout while the Figma component lives in Data Display; uses a native <button> and a redrawn grade pill.

components.name: Result Card
components.description: A generic full-width list row for search results and history lists (buyers, policies, drafts) that expands like an accordion to show details.
components.commentary: Figma retired Result Card in favour of the generic Horizontal Card (Type=Slot); the code component remains.

components.name: Policy Result Card
components.description: A generic full-width list row for search results and history lists (buyers, policies, drafts) that expands like an accordion to show details.
components.commentary: Figma retired Policy Result Card in favour of the Horizontal Card; the code component remains.

components.name: Grade
components.description: A read-only pill that shows a buyer's credit grade (1 to 10), whether it is manual or automatic, and optionally its numeric score.
components.commentary: The nc grade has insufficient contrast (white on grey-300).

components.name: Policy Color
components.description: A read-only round pill that shows a policy's color code (Green, Yellow, Orange, Red, U, N) as a letter, optionally followed by the color name.
components.commentary: ZeroHeight page still says "Tech Planned" but the component exists in code (added 2026-11-04); it has no story yet. Missing for ready: story.

components.name: Accordion
components.description: A collapsible section: a clickable title row that shows or hides the content placed in its slot.
components.commentary: No aria-controls on the trigger.

components.name: Timeline
components.description: A collapsible, status-colored group of dated events, read from top to bottom like a history.
components.commentary: Figma page marked Design WIP.

components.name: Timeline Event
components.description: One dated event of a Timeline group, colored by status.
components.commentary: Figma page marked Design WIP.

components.name: Identifier
components.description: A read-only identifier (company ID, policy key) shown as a small chip, with an optional leading icon; when copyable, the whole chip copies the value.
components.commentary: Figma source has 2 variants (Copyable/Focus as booleans) but the published library still has 4: republish pending.

components.name: Icon Tile
components.description: A square tile holding one icon, placed at the start of a result or a list row to say what kind of object it is.
components.commentary: Code radius of 5px on size M maps to Border/Radius/S (4px) in Figma.

components.name: Progress Bar
components.description: A thin horizontal bar showing a value out of 100: a score, a completion.
components.commentary: Story sits under Feedback while the Figma component lives in Data Display; no accessible name.

components.name: List Widget
components.description: One entry of a list in a board widget: a task (Job to do), a note (Notepad) or a news item (Newsfeed).
components.commentary: Figma List Item covers the entries of both ds-list-widget and ds-newsfeed.

components.name: Newsfeed
components.description: One entry of a list in a board widget: a task (Job to do), a note (Notepad) or a news item (Newsfeed).
components.commentary: Maps to the Figma List Item (news variant).

components.name: Chart
components.description: A line chart frame for board widgets (Grade, Exposure): grid lines, optional Y axis, X labels and one series.
components.commentary: No accessible name; hard-coded values flagged by the audit.

components.name: Pie Chart
components.description: A donut/pie chart from labelled segments.
components.commentary: Code-only; no Figma component. Missing for ready: Figma, doc.

components.name: Properties Panel
components.description: A label/value list in 1 to 4 columns, as a card or flat.
components.commentary: Retired from the Figma library (replaced by Card .Columns, which is private); heavily used in code. Missing for ready: Figma, doc.

components.name: Action Card
components.description: A card with icon, title and description that links to an action or area.
components.commentary: Code-only; uses --semantic-color-static-background-subtle-informative, which does not exist. Missing for ready: Figma, doc.

components.name: Badge
components.description: A small pill that gives a short status message with a color and, optionally, an icon.
components.commentary: Figma property Style corresponds to the code input variant.

components.name: Badge (counter)
components.description: A small red disc with a number that flags how many new or pending items sit behind an element.
components.commentary: Figma-only component: in code it exists only as the counter input of ds-tab.

components.name: Skeleton Item
components.description: A grey placeholder bar with a moving shimmer that holds the place of content while it loads.
components.commentary: Code, story, Figma and doc all in place.

components.name: Spinner
components.description: A small rotating ring that shows that something is loading.
components.commentary: Figma variant property is the default name "Property 1".

components.name: Toaster
components.description: A temporary message in the bottom right corner that confirms the result of an action or reports a problem.
components.commentary: Figma action is a Button, code uses a Link; hard-coded width.

components.name: Snackbar
components.description: A short, dark message at the bottom center of the screen that confirms a small action for two seconds.
components.commentary: Code, story, Figma and doc all in place.

components.name: Functional Notice
components.description: An inline message block that stays on the page to inform, warn or report an error about the content around it.
components.commentary: No content slot in Figma while code projects content under the message; dismiss button passes icon="close" to ds-button-icon, which has no icon input.

components.name: Tooltip
components.description: A small label that appears on hover or focus to name or explain an element.
components.commentary: Used through the [dsTooltip] directive; no aria-describedby and no Escape handling.

components.name: Popover
components.description: A floating panel anchored to an element that shows contextual content, with an optional title, illustration and actions.
components.commentary: No role, no focus management, no Escape; close button passes icon="close" to ds-button-icon (no icon input).

components.name: Popin
components.description: A small modal dialog that asks the user to confirm, cancel or choose before an action goes on.
components.commentary: Figma Popin = code ds-confirm-dialog. Figma Success tone has no code tone and danger reuses the warning glyph; role="alertdialog" is set on both the host and the inner box.

components.name: Header
components.description: The global application bar of Qirin: brand logo, main navigation, shortcut actions and the user account, on the brand blue band.
components.commentary: Code, story, Figma and doc all in place.

components.name: Side Navigation
components.description: Collapsible left navigation for moving between the sections of a dossier or a product area.
components.commentary: Figma Side Navigation = code ds-side-nav; Open default is inverted between Figma and code.

components.name: Side Navigation Item
components.description: One entry of the side navigation rail.
components.commentary: Code, story, Figma and doc all in place.

components.name: Page Header
components.description: The top block of a page under the global Header: object topbox, breadcrumbs, page title with its actions, and tabs.
components.commentary: Figma component lives in the Data Display library (page Topbox), not in Layout.

components.name: Page Title
components.description: The page heading with identifier, status badge and one optional action link.
components.commentary: Code-only; the Figma Page Header carries the title inside its own layout. Missing for ready: Figma, doc.

components.name: Modal
components.description: A blocking dialog over a dimmed backdrop, for a focused task that must be completed or dismissed before returning to the page.
components.commentary: Carries dsFocusTrap; hard-coded px and rgba in its SCSS; default Size differs between Figma and code.

components.name: Modal Header
components.description: The title bar of a Modal.
components.commentary: Code, story, Figma and doc all in place.

components.name: Modal Content
components.description: The scrollable body slot of a Modal.
components.commentary: Code, story, Figma and doc all in place.

components.name: Modal Footer
components.description: The action bar of a Modal, with an optional back button.
components.commentary: Code, story, Figma and doc all in place.

components.name: Drawer
components.description: A panel that slides in from the right edge to hold a secondary task (filters, details) without leaving the page.
components.commentary: Story has no autodocs tag, so the Storybook link opens the Default story.

components.name: Filter Drawer
components.description: A Drawer preset to build and save filters.
components.commentary: Code-only; the Figma Drawer master is used with local contents. Missing for ready: Figma, doc.

components.name: Flyout
components.description: The base floating panel used by menus and dropdowns.
components.commentary: Code-only base panel (no page uses it directly). Missing for ready: Figma, doc.

components.name: Flyout Item
components.description: A row of the base Flyout panel.
components.commentary: Code-only internal; Figma Flyout Item is covered by ds-flyout-menu-item. Missing for ready: Figma, doc.

components.name: Flyout Section
components.description: A titled section of the base Flyout panel.
components.commentary: See state rule. Missing for ready: Figma, doc.

components.name: Spotlight
components.description: A command-palette search overlay with recents and keyboard navigation.
components.commentary: Story title sits outside the Design System/* taxonomy (UI/Spotlight). Missing for ready: Figma, doc.

components.name: Shortcuts Panel
components.description: A panel listing keyboard shortcuts by group, with a keyboard map view.
components.commentary: No story and no Figma component. Missing for ready: story, Figma, doc.

components.name: Shortcut Row
components.description: One shortcut line: label, keys and context.
components.commentary: Internal of Shortcuts Panel; no story. Missing for ready: story, Figma, doc.

components.name: Keyboard Map
components.description: A keyboard-shaped map showing which keys have shortcuts.
components.commentary: Internal of Shortcuts Panel; no story. Missing for ready: story, Figma, doc.

components.name: Keycap
components.description: A single keyboard key cap.
components.commentary: No story and no Figma component. Missing for ready: story, Figma, doc.

components.name: Shortcut Keys
components.description: A sequence of Keycaps for one shortcut.
components.commentary: No story and no Figma component. Missing for ready: story, Figma, doc.

components.name: Icon
components.description: The SVG icon wrapper that renders a glyph from the code icon registry.
components.commentary: Figma wrapper is Icon Functional from the NDBX Web library; the code has its own registry, not NDBX. Figma library file is outside the Qirin files. Missing for ready: doc.

components.name: Logo
components.description: The Qirin brand mark and app name, in default or reversed colors.
components.commentary: Figma component key known, library file not identified. Missing for ready: doc.

components.name: Divider
components.description: A horizontal or vertical separator line.
components.commentary: Figma Divider has no vertical variant (vertical lines use a rotated instance). Missing for ready: doc.

components.name: Flag
components.description: A country flag SVG from an ISO country code.
components.commentary: Code-only; no Figma component. Missing for ready: Figma, doc.

components.name: Focus Trap
components.description: A directive that traps focus inside a dialog and restores it to the trigger on close.
components.commentary: Directive, not a visual component; no story. Applied on ds-modal and ds-confirm-dialog. Missing for ready: story, Figma, doc.

components.name: Breadcrumbs - Topbox
components.description: The breadcrumb row variant used inside the Page Header.
components.commentary: Figma-only sub-element of Page Header; in code it is the breadcrumb input of ds-page-header. Missing for ready: code, story, doc.

components.name: Tabs - Topbox
components.description: The tab row variant used inside the Page Header.
components.commentary: Figma-only sub-element of Page Header; in code it is the tabs input of ds-page-header. Missing for ready: code, story, doc.

components.commentary: Local to the Qirin · Search Figma file (v1.0, Ready for dev); implemented inside src/app/pages/search, no story and no doc by design (not a library component).

components.description: The small toolbar shown on a board slot.
